title: blemees-workflow human-input directory
description: Schema for the shared `human-inputs.json` file. Catalogues the inputs agents may invoke `request-input` on. Working states reference these by id via `State.human_inputs`.

human_inputs.description: Map of human-input-id → definition. Use a `general` entry for catch-all escalation; list specialised ids for structured questions (e.g., `clarify-scope`, `needs-arch-review`).

description.description: What kind of input this entry captures. Read by humans choosing what to answer.

agent_prepares.description: Optional template path the agent fills before invoking `request-input` with this id. Mirrors the human-gate catalog's same-named field.

rationale.description: Optional inline rationale or pointer to a sidecar markdown file.
